description:
## Finding
\`README.md:133\` and \`pkix-path/README.md:97-98\` claim:
> Name constraints — RFC 5280 §4.2.1.10 (DNS, RFC 822, URI, DirectoryName)

But \`pkix-path/src/lib.rs\`:
- \`name_type_bit\` (L1576) tracks \`IpAddress\` (\`NcTypeMask::IP_ADDRESS\` at L1549).
- \`name_matches_subtree\` (L1645–1647) dispatches IP address matching.
- \`matches_ip_address\` (L1752) implements RFC 5280-style IP address NC matching for both IPv4 (8-byte mask+addr) and IPv6 (32-byte mask+addr).

## Why P2
Section 0 anchor — the README is a feature list that downstream consumers depend on for capability decisions. Under-reporting capability is less harmful than over-reporting, but a CA/auditor checking \"does this validator support IP NC?\" reading the README will conclude no, when the answer is yes. They will then choose a less-suitable validator on a false negative.

## Fix
Update both READMEs to list IpAddress in the supported NC name forms, e.g.:
> Name constraints — RFC 5280 §4.2.1.10 (DNS, RFC 822, URI, DirectoryName, IpAddress)

## Scope reference
\`README.md:133\`, \`pkix-path/README.md:97-98\`, supporting code at \`pkix-path/src/lib.rs:1549,1576,1645-1647,1752\`.
title: P2: Workspace README under-reports IP address NameConstraints support
